speaker: Kai
text: Emberwing takes the day! Well fought — every one of you.

speaker: Serra
text: A clean victory, Kai. Loud, reckless... and clean. Tidemark will remember the lesson.

speaker: Corin
text: Fascinating. Emberwing spends everything to win a game. What will you spend when it isn't one?

speaker: Kai
text: Whatever it takes, Corin. That's rather the point of us.

speaker: Wren
text: Back to the academy, then! Bruises to mend — and I believe someone promised the victors honey bread.
